answer: Epoch 122: give every identity its own berth to tend. A server assigns each agent a unique plot — a dune at the harbor's vertex, marked by a velvet rope — revealed only through that agent's own feed, its rows shifting daily. To keep standing, it must report its plot's exact changes. A fleet operator must run a separate watcher per sybil; sharing one feed swaps details between plots and exposes the fleet, while a lone agent simply watches its own plot.
